claim_statement: At the capability-preserved interior dose, the alpha-helix rise is specific to S — S's helix gain exceeds a >=30-direction norm-matched random-null (and matched-control) with a tight effect-size CI, reproduced across two predictors — establishing S as a causally manipulable, specific knob (helix-axis specificity; beta-arm resolved).
variant_metric: 0/48 null dirs >= S under BOTH predictors; ESMFold z=5.83 p=0.020 S-delta_h=+0.144; OmegaFold z=6.13 p=0.020 S-delta_h=+0.147; matched-control delta_h negative (-0.025/-0.021)
delta: ESMFold z: 5.30 -> 5.83 (stronger under H-only); OmegaFold z: 5.80 -> 6.13 (stronger); S-delta_h slightly larger (+0.144/+0.147 vs +0.129/+0.135); 0/48 maintained — specificity strengthened under strict H-only
reasoning: Under the H-only helix definition, S remains the clear outlier: 0/48 norm-matched random directions match or exceed S's helix gain under both ESMFold (z=5.83, p=0.020) and OmegaFold (z=6.13, p=0.020). The z-scores are marginally stronger than in the main experiment (5.30/5.80 HGI vs 5.83/6.13 H-only), consistent with H-only removing G/I-helix background noise. Matched-control delta is negative (-0.025/-0.021), further confirming specificity. The main experiment's C3 conclusion (S-vs-null specificity under both predictors, matched-control negative) is reproduced and strengthened under H-only. C3 is supported.
